dispositionReason: The exact candidate fails automatic composition and feedback boundaries: the connected district/public-realm span falls to 54.03% in maximized regular layout, the conservative connected-green terrain share outside the entire district bounding box remains above 25% in every governed layout, several occupied/context structures remain visually detached from continuous frontage, obvious residential repetition and mixed fidelity remain, and a blocked pointer placement emits the contradictory action update Road construction approved.

leaseConsumption.computerUseTransportInterruption: The Computer Use transport closed once while the command guide was open. PID 28390 remained alive; QA reattached to that same process and did not launch again.

measurementMethod.source: Fresh real-app PNG captures from the one isolated candidate process; no author screenshots or fixture-only substitutions were used.
measurementMethod.safeAperture: For each capture, exclude the fixed top status/HUD rows and bottom command-deck rows. Coordinates are recorded as x, y, width, height in screenshot pixels.
measurementMethod.connectedDistrictSpan: Largest four-connected road/curb/public-realm component. Pixel inclusion: 35<=R<=150, 30<=G<=145, 28<=B<=140, max(R,G,B)-min(R,G,B)<=28, abs(R-G)<=18, and R>=G-8. Width is the inclusive component bounding width divided by safe-aperture width. Detached sprites outside that component are not credited as connected authored fabric.
measurementMethod.conservativePlainTerrain: Largest four-connected green component with 25<=R<=135, 45<=G<=155, 20<=B<=130, G-R>=9, and G-B>=10. The reported numerator discards every classified pixel inside the entire connected-district bounding rectangle, so it is a conservative lower bound on broad connected green outside the district rather than a count of parcel ground.

checks.criterion: Road, curb, sidewalk, and parcel fabric continuity
checks.observation: The main loop reads continuously with curbs and inset parcel grounds at regular and compact sizes; no seam or fallback was observed in that connected component.

checks.criterion: Grounded frontages and no floating structures
checks.observation: The upper-left and far-right residences plus the lower service building and water tower remain outside the connected road/public-realm component without a clearly continuous road-facing frontage; they read as detached context structures.
No sprite overlap, critical clipping, or fallback texture was observed in the governed captures.

Orange masonry, dark-roof residences repeat as an obvious stamp across the loop and detached edges, while City Hall and the park carry materially finer detail than several residences and service structures.

Pointer selection exposed cost, target, likely consequence, recovery, and Escape cancellation, but the blocked Road placement at block 6,8 simultaneously emitted Action update: Road construction approved while the build decision and map semantics said BLOCKED and Unavailable.
After Escape cancelled placement, Right Arrow moved map focus and selected City Hall at block 12,12 with condition, utilities, pollution, vitality, and primary-action semantics.
The command guide opened with searchable categorized commands and availability text; Escape closed it and restored map focus.

checks.criterion: Compact commands, Focus City, decisions, and notices
checks.observation: The 900x600 content layout collapsed categories into Catalog without clipping. Focus City retained identity, treasury, decision priority, notices, selected context, speeds, and Exit. Opening notices exited Focus City and exposed a keyboard-readable journal.
HUD metrics, priority, trajectory, command availability, map selection, Focus City rail, notices, and settings exposed explicit roles, descriptions, values, and help.
Reduce ambient animation toggled on in the isolated preference domain; the maximized layout retained the same world, HUD, map focus, and command semantics without displacement.

defects.title: Maximized regular camera drops connected district span below the frozen minimum
defects.reproduction: Start the exact isolated candidate, dismiss Welcome, pause, maximize the regular command layout, and inspect the fresh city without Focus City.
defects.expected: Connected authored occupied/public-realm fabric spans at least 60% of the safe map width and plain terrain remains at or below 25%.
defects.actual: Connected component width is 690/1277 = 54.03%; conservative connected green outside the entire district bounding rectangle is 61.96% of the safe aperture.

defects.title: Broad connected green and detached context structures still dominate the opening
defects.reproduction: Compare the paused regular, exact compact, compact Focus City, maximized regular, and maximized Focus City captures.
defects.expected: No plain-terrain component exceeds 25%; every occupied place has a continuous grounded road-facing frontage; repetition and mixed fidelity are absent.
defects.actual: The conservative outside-district green lower bound ranges from 32.64% to 61.96%; edge residences, the lower service structure, and water tower remain visually detached; residential stamping and mixed structure detail remain obvious.

defects.title: Blocked pointer placement announces construction approval
defects.reproduction: Enter Build > Roads and pointer-select occupied block 6,8.
defects.expected: The action update agrees with the blocked decision and unavailable map primary action.
defects.actual: The action update says Road construction approved while the build decision says BLOCKED: Demolish the existing structure and map AX says Unavailable. Escape cancellation works.
defects.evidence: Fresh Computer Use accessibility trace recorded in this result.
